title: Strip estimate ∫⁻ ofReal(‖Dg‖·|η|) dμ ≤ ofReal(c)·μ(W ∩ S)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, g : ℝ^P → ℝ, η : ℝ^P → Λ^k(ℝ^P) any k-form (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k), W, S ⊆ ℝ^P and c ∈ ℝ. Assume ‖Dg(x)‖ ≤ c for all x (operator norm of fderiv ℝ g x), Dg(x) ≠ 0 implies x ∈ S, tsupport η ⊆ W, and |η(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm). Then ∫⁻ ofReal(‖Dg(x)‖·|η(x)|) dμ(x) ≤ ofReal(c)·μ(W ∩ S) in [0,∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (W S : Set (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ c) → (∀ x, fderiv ℝ g x ≠ 0 → x ∈ S) → tsupport η ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (η x) ≤ 1) → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm (η x)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * μ (W ∩ S)
